definitions.explanation: A genetic tendency to develop allergic conditions such as eczema, asthma, and hay fever. In everyday Japanese, most commonly refers specifically to atopic dermatitis (atopic eczema).

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ころ→〜ころ：03091_koro⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧アトピーだ。
examples.english: I've had atopic dermatitis since childhood.

examples.japanese: アトピー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪化|あっか}した→悪化する：18844_akkasuru⟧。

アトピー⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦{皮膚炎|ひふえん}→皮膚炎：23596_hifuen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{完治|かんち}→完治：12268_kanchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{適切|てきせつ}→適切：01621_tekisetsu⟧な⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{症状|しょうじょう}→症状：03234_shoujou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Atopic dermatitis is hard to cure completely, but proper treatment can control the symptoms.

notes:
In Japanese, アトピー almost always refers to atopic dermatitis (eczema) specifically, even though the medical term is broader. Very common in daily conversation as many Japanese people suffer from this condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アトピー⟦{性|せい}→性：09880_sei⟧⟦{皮膚炎|ひふえん}→皮膚炎：23596_hifuen⟧: atopic dermatitis (the full medical term)
- アトピー⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧: atopy-prone skin
- アトピー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: for eczema to flare up
- アトピー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}る→治る：19598_naoru⟧: for eczema to clear up
- アトピー⟦{体質|たいしつ}→体質：08243_taishitsu⟧: atopic constitution; tendency toward allergies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{湿疹|しっしん}→湿疹：06951_shisshin⟧: eczema, rash — a general medical term for skin rashes; broader than アトピー
- ⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧: allergy — the broader category of immune hypersensitivity
- ⟦{肌荒|はだあ}れ→肌荒れ：08421_hadaare⟧: rough skin, skin irritation — a general term for skin problems

CULTURAL NOTE:
Atopic dermatitis is extremely common in Japan. There are many products marketed specifically for アトピー⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧, and the topic comes up frequently in conversations about children's health.
